# How templates work

A template is a message Meta reviewed in advance. It is the only kind that reaches a person outside the 24-hour window.

Each template belongs to a WhatsApp Business Account, has a language and a category (marketing, utility or authentication, which Meta may change during review), and numbered variables that a send fills. get_template lists the variables. A template with named variables is listed but cannot be sent yet.

create_template submits a new one, which starts as pending. Meta approves or rejects it later, and only an approved template can be sent. Meta can also pause or disable a template it approved before.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#how-templates-work
